mechanisms.title: Text Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Text is master data with a search strategy.
mechanisms.question: Which text should appear here, and where did it come from?
mechanisms.determination: For each configured text type, the access sequence searches potential source texts in order and copies/links the selected text into the SD document according to the text rules.

failure_modes.prove: Check procedure assignment → text type → access sequence → source text existence → copy/reference behavior.

failure_modes.symptom: Old text survives into a follow-on document
failure_modes.prove: Check whether the target copies predecessor text or redetermines from master data.

tests.setup: Maintain a customer-material text and configure it as a source for an item text.
tests.assert: Sales item receives the text when no higher-priority source wins.

mechanisms.title: Output Management / Output Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: First identify the output framework. Then debug the rule path.
mechanisms.question: What message is produced, for whom, through which channel, with which form and timing?
mechanisms.determination: SAP S/4HANA can use different output frameworks depending on the application context. S/4HANA Output Control uses output parameter determination and business rules to derive channel, recipient, form template and dispatch parameters. Classic SD Output Determination (SD-BF-OC) uses the condition technique with output types, procedures, access sequences and condition records. Diagnose the active framework before tracing individual rules.
configuration_surfaces: Output Parameter Determination / Define Business Rules for Output Determination
Classic SD Output Determination using the Condition Technique

failure_modes.symptom: Document exists but customer receives nothing
failure_modes.prove: First identify the active output framework. Then check output creation/proposal → rule or condition result → recipient → channel/medium → timing/status → rendering/send error.
For S/4 Output Control, trace the decision-table result and partner data. For classic SD output, trace procedure → output type → access sequence → condition record before editing the form.

failure_modes.symptom: Team debugs OPD but the application still uses classic SD output determination
failure_modes.prove: Confirm the application-specific output framework before changing rules. The two models have different configuration and trace paths.

tests.setup: For an application using S/4HANA Output Control, configure different output parameters for two controlled business contexts.
tests.assert: Output parameters follow the maintained business rules and create visible output items.

tests.setup: For an application using classic SD Output Determination, maintain a valid output condition record for one key combination and omit it for another.
tests.assert: The output proposal follows the configured procedure, access sequence and condition-record search.
